ModMetaData.name: Research Overhaul Tool
ModMetaData.author: N4M3L3S
ModMetaData.description: Create custom research projects with any item from any mod. Safe to add mid-save - all changes apply without reloading. Includes a preset system to save and share your custom research trees. Compatible with YART (Yet Another Research Tree) for better visualization. Place this mod last in your load order for best results. If the game freezes when you close the editor it's because adapting the whole research of the game is heavy - and happening in sweet real time.
